title: source-map-url is deprecated
summary: The maintainer deprecated source-map-url and recommends convert-source-map for working with source map comments.

constraints: Preserve JavaScript and CSS comment forms, inline and external map URLs, insertion position, removal behavior, and malformed-input handling.

steps.title: Move to convert-source-map
steps.instructions: Replace source-map-url parsing and mutation calls with convert-source-map equivalents and explicit handling for any unsupported comment forms.

verification.purpose: Run inline, external, JavaScript, CSS, malformed, and repository tests.
